ai.prompt: I'm looking at the Solaris UI documentation for {{component}} ({{url}}). Help me understand how to use it. Be ready to explain concepts, give examples, or help debug based on it.

color.note: The checked dot follows the semantic color.

description.label: Form control for single selection with native input, multiple appearances, colors, sizes, description, label position, and states.
description.note: Secondary text under the label, exposed to assistive technology via aria-describedby.

examples.note: A single option within a set of mutually exclusive choices. The native input stays accessible.

installation.note: Install the Solaris UI package and import the radio components.

label-layout.note: The label sits after the control by default; start mirrors the row.

props.note: Props table coming soon with the table component.

size-density.note: Size and density combine into a 3x3 matrix: both change the control circle, density also changes the label gap.
